product.title: Outlander Film Locations Day Trip from Edinburgh

description.text: Follow Outlander filming locations from Edinburgh to Doune Castle, Culross, Falkland, and Linlithgow Palace. A local English-speaking guide covers castle sets, village streets, and palace ruins on a 9.5-hour air-conditioned day trip. Stops include Doune Castle, Culross, Falkland, Linlithgow Palace. Departure is from the Royal Mile, with stories about actors and film sets between the historic sites. Castle Courtyard and village lanes used on screen are easier to place with a guide than from a self-drive map. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided Outlander locations day without plotting castle opening times alone.

highlights: Full-day Outlander film locations tour from Edinburgh
Marvel at historic landmarks such as Doune Castle
Visit beautiful filming locations including Culross, and Falkland
Hear stories about Outlander’s actors and film sets from an expert guide
